references.text: The word of the Lord came to Abram in a vision, showing how God reveals Himself to prophets through visions
God appeared to Abimelech in a dream at night, an example of God's communication through dreams
Jacob had a dream in which the Lord revealed Himself to him, illustrating God speaking through dreams
The angel of God spoke to Jacob in a dream, an example of divine revelation through dreams
God spoke to Israel in night visions, confirming the pattern of revelation through visions
The word of the Lord was rare in those days; visions were not common - referring to prophetic visions as a form of communication
The Lord revealed Himself to Samuel at Shiloh through His word
The Lord appeared to Solomon in a dream at night
God speaks in dreams, in night visions, when deep sleep falls upon people
Isaiah, son of Amoz, saw a vision - prophetic revelation through a vision
Isaiah saw the Lord in a vision, an example of prophetic revelation
The words of Jeremiah as the word of the Lord came to him - prophetic calling and revelation
Ezekiel's visions of God, prophetic revelation through visions
The Lord answered Daniel in a night vision
Daniel had dreams and visions in his mind while he lay on his bed
Ezekiel saw the appearance of the Lord's glory in a vision
The Lord spoke to the prophets and gave many visions and parables through them
Joel's prophecy that sons and daughters will prophesy, and the old will dream dreams
Peter's speech about Joel's prophecy: their young men will see visions, and their old men will dream dreams
God spoke in times past many times and in many ways to the fathers through the prophets
